criteria.evidence: acceptance.go problem strings; plan.go acceptPlan loop with planRounds=2, writeProblems, revise(); TestRunBaseGatePasses, TestRunBaseGateChangesTree and TestRunBaseGateStillPassesAfterRevision assert two plan sessions and the messages
